name: When is it better to hire a specialized excavation company versus a general contractor for excavation?

mainEntity.name: When is it better to hire a specialized excavation company versus a general contractor for excavation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For substantial, coordinated residential renovations like those AKN Design Group specializes in, it is typically more beneficial to have your general contractor manage the excavation. This approach ensures a single point of coordination, integrating excavation seamlessly into the broader design-build process for home additions, whole-home remodels, or comprehensive outdoor living spaces. This avoids potential delays or miscommunications that can arise when managing separate excavation vendors.
acceptedAnswer.description: For complex renovations, it's better to have your general contractor manage excavation to ensure seamless integration and a single point of coordination.
